rivers.name: River Lum
rivers.note: rises at a dead end south of the Wilderness, runs south past Lumbridge into the sea east of the Lumbridge swamp

rivers.name: River Elid
rivers.note: dead end north of the Shantay Pass, runs south past Nardah into the sea at Sophanem

rivers.name: River Salve, lower reach
rivers.note: the Salve widens south of Paterdomus and runs on south to the sea; both ends touch open water so it needs saying

rivers.name: Ardougne river
rivers.note: out of the lake west of the Fishing Guild, between East and West Ardougne, past Yanille into the marsh to the south-west; the marsh is not blue on the map, so by default that end looked like a dead end and the river ran backwards

rivers.name: Karamja river
rivers.note: opens to the sea on three sides; run it from the north inlet south and split to the east and west coasts rather than meeting head on in the jungle

rivers.name: Hosidius river
rivers.note: leaves the Piscarilius canals and splits to the bay west of Hosidius and the south coast

rivers.name: Lake Molch outflow
rivers.note: from Lake Molch west to the Shayzien bay
